description: Can the object-list slot fields mark the frames of a false closing? Frames beyond 40 m with ego above 10 m/s where the radar's ACC target and an object-list track at its lateral position describe the same car. False closing: object-list relative speed more than 2.5 m/s below the ACC speed (and below -2 m/s). Real closing: ACC relative speed below -2 m/s with the object list within 1 m/s. Gradient-boosted classifier, 5-fold cross-validation grouped by drive; AUC 0.5 = no separation.

auc_radar_fields_only.note: object relative speed, acceleration 84|10, 1 s speed change, 240|7 and range

auc_with_ego_speed_and_acceleration_adde.note: not usable by a controller: ego is already decelerating when the lead really brakes (median -0.79 m/s2) and not during false closings (0.00), so these features carry the driver's reaction

independent_witness_0x680.note: same question on vehicles outside the ACC target, labelled by the 0x680 speed (range-stratified AUC, too-closing frames against frames within 1 m/s)
